packageRules.description: Playwright's npm package and Docker image move in lockstep; the image tag can lag the npm release, so automerge stays off to stop a solo npm-only bump from landing unmatched.
Kratos and Hydra release together and update the day they ship, as one MR a session reviews; automerge stays off.

The .gitlab-ci.yml component pins track a single dunn.dev/pipeline release and must bump together in one MR with the portal/Containerfile runtime base; automerge stays off because a stale base pin breaks the next tag build once the old image tag is registry-GC'd.

portal/Containerfile pins the ci-runtime-node base literally on its FROM line, because the container-publishing standard asserts the pin there and an ARG indirection hides it. The native dockerfile manager owns that line; group it with the component pins and keep automerge off so one MR still moves both and a base bump never lands unmatched.
The check jobs in .gitlab-ci.yml run on the pipeline catalog's ci image; it moves with the component pins in one MR, with automerge off.
@types/node tracks the Node major in mise.toml, which ci-pins grades; a newer major would type APIs the runtime lacks.
